verdicts.reason: A breaks the design apart: the RSVP pill sits top-left above the logo, TASTINGS is cut off from the other badges, which are stacked at the far right, and SOLSTICE PRESENTS has dropped below the URL. The headline is tiny and the body text is barely legible, so nothing reads as the focal point. B gives 'Sunset Sessions' clear prominence and keeps the date and badges together, but RSVP is shrunk to badge size and buried in the badge row, the 'Pier 9' line wraps to leave a lone '9', and the broken image placeholder collides with the time/location text.
